transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I keep thinking everyone would be better off if I just weren’t here anymore, and these thoughts about not wanting to wake up won’t stop. It has just become too heavy to carry on my own, and I didn't know what else to do.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this been going on for at least two weeks or longer?
Yes, it’s been much longer than two weeks. This has been going on steadily for a little over a year now, starting in the months after my father's sudden death. It just hasn't let up at all.
Have you had any previous periods of low mood like this before the one that started after your father's death, or has this been your first episode?
No, I have never experienced a period of low mood like this before. This is the very first time in my life I've had to deal with these kinds of feelings.
